notes.title: Massive Update! A New Adventure Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392328/1a03ef0b6fe8658cccc7c66732974b6ed1d0d350.png[/img]

Dear players, the highly anticipated massive update has finally arrived! Everything in the game has been transformed:
[h3][b]
Cartoon Comics Graphics[/b][/h3]
The game has been reborn with a fresh cartoon-comics-style look. Enjoy vivid adventures in a uniquely styled world.

[h3][b]17 New Content Packs[/b][/h3]
From prehistoric dinosaur realms to futuristic space exploration, 17 unique content packs have been added. Each offers brand-new themes and challenges.

[h3][b]Enhanced Cop Chase System[/b][/h3]
The police are now smarter and more strategic. With various tactics and maneuvers, they’ll keep you on your toes, delivering a more thrilling gameplay experience.

Download the update now and immerse yourself in this completely transformed gaming world!

notes.title: Added an event where you have to poop because you eat too many burgers
notes.content:
[h2]1) Add being full and pooping[/h2]
Each stage limits the number of burgers you can eat to level up. When that number is reached, Choi is full and has to poop.

[h2]2) Add penalty of dying in the first stage[/h2]
If you die in the first stage, the number of accumulated burgers is reduced.

[h2]3) Adjust Balance[/h2]
Adjusted Balance.
